_: Scene ACTION performance (IDEAS §1b first slice): a scene that does more than talk. Builds on the presence-gated banter shape (autoStart + two essential unique NPCs in the Sleeping Giant Inn), but the scene now opens with a non-dialog BEAT phase: actor 0 (Borin) WALKS across the inn to the vanilla RiverwoodInnCenterMarker via a Travel package, paced by an 8s Timer action, THEN the two NPCs argue. This proves the two new SceneAction types — Package (run an AI package over a phase window) and Timer (pause a phase) — decoded from vanilla dunTolvaldsCaveCrownScene / BardSongs* scenes. Test: coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn (after save+reload on an old save), stand near both → Borin strides to the centre, waits, then they trade barbs. Travel stays inside ONE interior cell (same navmesh) so the engine doesn't reject cross-cell pathing — see package2_spec.json's note. package bundles MFSceneBanterController.pex automatically (autoStart).

packages._: Travel package the SCENE drives (not assigned to the NPC) — referenced by the scene's Package action. Destination is the vanilla RiverwoodInnCenterMarker, in the SAME interior cell as the NPCs so Travel walks on the inn navmesh.

quests._: Controller host quest. StartGameEnabled so MFSceneBanterController's OnInit arms the poll.
quests.name: ModForge Scene Action

scenes._phases: phase 0 is a lineless BEAT — Borin walks to the inn centre (Package action) over an 8s window (Timer action). Phases 1-4 are the spoken argument.

lines: There you are, Hilda. We need to talk about the ale you owe me.
Owe you? That swill wasn't worth a clipped septim.
Ha! Buy me a drink and we're even.
